hits.snippet: We are pleased to announce that BSR’s Board of Directors has appointed Diederik Timmer as our new President and CEO, effective September 1, succeeding longtime leader Aron Cramer. A 20-year leader in sustainable business, Diederik joins BSR following a distinguished career, including roles such as President at Glass Lewis & Co, EVP at Morningstar Sustainalytics, Chair of US Social Investment Forum (US SIF), and service as a board member at Knology. Diederik joins BSR at a pivotal moment as the framework conditions shaping the world undergo fundamental change. A proven business leader, his experience delivering innovative solutions, embracing data and new technologies, and providing leadership consistent with BSR’s values aligns with the Board’s vision for the organization’s future and our enduring mission to create a just and sustainable world. We extend our deepest gratitude to Aron, who is stepping down after 31 years at BSR, including 22 years as CEO. Under Aron’s leadership, BSR has grown into a global organization, collaboration leader, and trusted advisor to more than 250 member companies.
